name: micro_dmem
description: Microbenchmarks: pointer-chase latency over working sets 1 KiB..256 KiB (random and address order), load and store streams (cycles per load/store)
expect: MICRO CHECK OK micro_dmem iterations={iterations} regions=19
units: loads/stores per region (cycles/iter = cycles per load/store)

region_ops.1: region overhead: call + return of an empty kernel (cycles/iter is not per-op)
region_ops.2: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 1 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.3: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 2 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.4: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 4 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.5: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 8 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.6: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 12 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.7: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 16 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.8: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 20 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.9: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 24 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.10: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 32 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.11: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 64 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.12: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 128 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.13: dependent ld, random cyclic order over 256 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.14: dependent ld, address order over 4 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.15: dependent ld, address order over 8 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.16: dependent ld, address order over 16 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.17: dependent ld, address order over 32 KiB (one node per 64-byte line)
region_ops.18: ld, sequential over a 64 KiB buffer, every doubleword (8 per line), no consumer
region_ops.19: sd, sequential over a 64 KiB buffer whose lines are all dirty, every doubleword
